customer: Hello, I'm hoping to sell my paid-off pickup truck to Northwind Auto so I can move up to something bigger, but I can't find the paper title anywhere. I live in Brevin. Is there still a way to sell it to you, and how long would getting a replacement take? Thank you for your help.
agent: Thanks for reaching out. As explained in our article "Selling a paid-off car when the title is lost," we'll need a duplicate title from Brevin before we can complete the purchase, since we can't buy a fully paid-off vehicle without one. You can still get an offer on your pickup and book an appointment while you wait for the duplicate. How long it takes depends on the state, so Brevin will be able to tell you its timeline.
